Cockroach Janta Party's Saurav Das has moved the Delhi High Court after being stopped from travelling to the UK for an Oxford Students’ Union event. While Das challenges the travel restrictions, the Ministry of External Affairs says a show-cause notice was issued over a discrepancy in his place of birth. The court will hear his plea on November 26. Here's what happened and what the government has said. Watch
